recipe.visualDefinition: A portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and plaid shirt, framed by a rigid geometric grid of solid color blocks and white negative space, utilizing a warm, sun-drenched color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's gaze directed toward the right, balanced by text on the left
Solid blue and red rectangles anchoring the corners of the central image
White L-shaped negative space framing the top-left and bottom-right
Text overlapping both the image and the solid color blocks
coreInvariants: Warm, golden-hour lighting on the subject's face
High-contrast black cowboy hat as a central silhouette
Strict horizontal and vertical alignment of all graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered horizontally but vertically offset to the top-right quadrant of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark silhouette of the cowboy hat against the warm stone background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left red banner, moves to the subject's face, then follows the large white text down to the blue block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large white borders on the left and right create a 'floating' effect for the central composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (terracotta, gold, brown) within the photograph.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue and stark white for structural framing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant tomato red used in the top-left banner and right-side gradient.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic blocks versus naturalistic, warm saturation in the photo.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different scales and tracking settings.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight and modern-classic feel.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and sharp corners.
Open-source alternative with similar wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and a red/brown plaid shirt. Use warm, golden-hour lighting. The background should be a textured stone wall. Mask the image into a central rectangle, leaving a white L-shaped border on the left and bottom. Add a solid navy blue square in the bottom-left corner and a red-to-orange vertical gradient bar on the far right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small red horizontal banner in the top-left. Typeset the subtitle in white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif inside it. Typeset the main display text in large, bold, white geometric sans-serif, stacked in three lines in the bottom-left, overlapping the blue square and the bottom of the photo.

verificationChecks: Does the blue block align with the bottom-left of the image?
Is the lighting on the subject consistently warm?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the cowboy hat is a solid dark silhouette.
Ensure the white text is legible over the plaid shirt.
Verify the three-line text stack is left-aligned.
Confirm the red banner is positioned partially over the white space and the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Framing + Warm Portraiture + Wide-Tracked Sans-Serif = 90s Americana Aesthetic
